summary: WSGI servers (uWSGI for controller and gateway, Gunicorn for hub and EDA) are the main source of API latency: they validate JWTs and run operations with a fixed number of workers, queueing requests when busy, with timeouts from client_request_timeout or the OpenShift Route. Almost every request also hits the database, so database and network latency are critical.
questions: What is the main source of AAP API latency?
Which WSGI server does automation controller use?
Why does database latency affect AAP API performance?
